explanation: Body 0 approaches the top-right corner of a thin vertical wall (wall 0 at [14,2.8] size 0.3x5.5, top at y=8.3). From step 22 to 23 it transitions from 0.0979 clearance to -0.0508 penetration, and at step 24 penetration deepens to -0.2004 exceeding 0.15 limit. The side/top corner contact is not resolved with sufficient positional correction within the 6 substeps, allowing the circle to sink into the side of the box while grazing the top edge. Reducing radius from 0.801 to 0.5 removes the corner grazing and avoids violation.
